resources.name: Bulk crystal structures of XCrY₂ (X=Li,Na; Y=S,Se,Te)

access.notes: Available from the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD) or from the original references (Vanlaar & Ijdo 1971; Kobayashi et al. 2016; Scheel 1974) cited as 36‑38 in the paper. They serve as starting points for constructing monolayer slabs.
Open‑source DFT package capable of HSE06 calculations. Replaces the proprietary VASP used in the paper.
Agent may write its own Monte Carlo code or use an open‑source library (e.g., ALPS) to simulate the Ising and Heisenberg models on a triangular lattice.
